newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady to higher, NYMEX narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady to higher, NYMEX narrowly mixed.

text.p: Brent futures edged up in late trading in Singapore on Monday, although overall interest was subdued ahead of London trading.
May Brent -- which took over as the front month on Friday -- was untraded but quoted at $19.75/$19.85 per barrel, up from the London close on Friday of $19.74.
June Brent futures traded at $19.65, five cents higher than London's Friday close.
Brokers said the market was continuing the firmer tone seen late last week, although resistance was expected at $19.90 to $19.95 on the front-month position.
April NYMEX crude was last traded at $21.30, up one cent from New York, while May was last traded at $21.19, down one cent.
NYMEX crude on the front two position was just 228 lots.

Brokers said NYMEX April crude would struggle to break above $21.50. The front month rose in New York as high as $21.45 -- the top end of the trading range since February 24 -- before it was knocked back by sellers.
